title.value: Model-based graph reinforcement learning for inductive traffic signal control
title.justification: The title reflects the central method (model-based graph reinforcement learning) and application (adaptive traffic signal control) discussed throughout the paper.
title.quote: "Model-based graph reinforcement learning for inductive traffic signal control"

extractions.description: The paper introduces MuJAM, a model-based reinforcement learning method using graph neural networks for adaptive traffic signal control. MuJAM aims to enhance scalability, data efficiency, and generalization to new traffic settings and road networks. It uses both cyclic and acyclic constraints to demonstrate zero-shot transferability and coordination at scale.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper discusses adaptive traffic signal control methods that aim to reduce traffic congestion, which is directly related to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and improving urban air quality.
climate_change_is_central.quote: "Adaptive-traffic-signal-control (ATSC) aims at minimizing traffic congestion which gives rise to a plethora of environmentally and socially harmful outcomes."
